neighbours.label: The ending piece (-AL, -ICAL, -AN, -AR, -INE) of an adjective written in ALL CAPS and split into several tokens, typically in an all-caps title or heading; the related all-caps noun (the place or field the adjective comes from), the same adjective in normal case, and other caps words in the heading stay low.
neighbours.short: ending piece of a split ALL-CAPS adjective (NA|VAL, TROP|ICAL)
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of L33/N261+ (drop only -0.01, the only reader found; the label has little to do with the feeder's mis/over prefix). Top examples mix ALL-CAPS title words with split lowercase participle prefixes (un|grazed, electro|cuted after was/been), which are not claimed here. The - pole also fires inside ALL-CAPS notices, on function words. Test sentences written blind by a label-only author.
